bottlenecks.mechanism: Technically completed work cannot be counted until it is verified, authorized, and accepted.
bottlenecks.mitigation: Use proof-carrying outputs, bounded permissions, and pre-agreed acceptance tests.
bottlenecks.name: Transfer trust and authorization
bottlenecks.release_condition: Transfer factor exceeds 0.85 with no material control failure.

bottlenecks.mechanism: Usable capacity can exceed the number of missions institutions are ready to assign and absorb.
bottlenecks.mitigation: Prioritize high-value bounded workflows and shorten procurement and onboarding.
bottlenecks.name: Absorptive demand
bottlenecks.release_condition: Adoption and utilization grow without a corresponding increase in rejection or rework.

compact_canonical_model.equation: Y_s(t)=B_s(t) min{Q_0 exp[int_0^t g_Q,s(u) du], M_s(t)D_s(t)U_s(t)}
compact_canonical_model.generalized_family: Y=B_X[alpha(B_Q Q)^(-rho)+(1-alpha)(B_Z Z)^(-rho)]^(-1/rho); rho->infinity yields the hard minimum.
compact_canonical_model.plain_language: Realized output is limited by technical capacity and absorptive demand, with branch-specific and transfer constraints applied exactly once.
compact_canonical_model.technical_growth_equation: g_Q,s=beta_theta theta_dot-beta_c c_dot/c-beta_tau tau_dot/tau+beta_A A_dot/(A+epsilon)+beta_P P_dot/P+beta_R R_dot/R
